tools.name: check
tools.title: Check for problems
tools.description: Looks for what Mike would otherwise catch in review: black frames and gaps, one-frame flickers, green screens that didn't key and white blocks that come and go. Notes, which don't fail it, are judgement calls: pictures zoomed past their own pixels; dead air (0.8 s or more of a still picture with nothing said and no sound effect or music swell: cut it, or keep it if the pause earns it); and page changes on the screen recording with no transition (push them if they're pages in an explainer or slides); and slivers, clips or gaps between clips on a track shorter than a frame. Renders the frames small, so a minute takes seconds. Run it with changed: true on what you changed before handing back. With cuts: true it checks only for words clipped at cuts, and gives the trims that fix them. ok is false when it finds a problem.

to.description: End. Default the end of the timeline. Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

changed.description: Only the stretches agents changed that are waiting for Mike's review.

quick.description: Only the checks that need no rendering: gaps, slivers and pictures zoomed past their own pixels. No dead air or page changes.

cuts.description: Only the cuts on the speech tracks, from the files' own sound (nothing rendered): a clippedWord problem where the voice runs right up to a cut, full band or above 4 kHz (a final "s"). Each has cut.fix, a trim into the nearest real pause (0.08 s quiet in both bands) within 0.3 s; commands holds them all, latest first, to apply with expectedRevision: revision. Run it after cutting the take.

width.description: How wide frames are rendered for the scan. Default 384.

tools.name: sync
tools.title: Sync picture and sound
tools.description: Two jobs. With delay: a webcam's picture lags its mic (Mike's by about 0.08 s), so lips and voice drift apart; every camera take (or the media files named) shows its picture that much later in the file, in the app, frames, review clips, check and exports; the sound, the cuts and word times stay put. 0 puts it back as recorded. Never slip clips by hand as well, or the delay doubles. Without delay or files it lists each file's delay and the default new camera takes get. With files (another camera angle, an external mic): lines each up with the camera take by sound, however much of the take it covers, and reports how much further into the file the same moment is (offset, positive when it started first), how far the clocks drift apart over the overlap, and a confidence (unrelated sound scores under 10; under 15 is refused and nothing changes). Then, as one undo step, it puts each file in the camera's take and places it beside the take's clips, linked (placeSynced): an angle on its own track above the camera's ("Angle 2"), off until the showAngle edit command shows it over a range, its own sound not placed; a sound file on Voice, with the camera's own sound there moved to a muted "Camera sound" track. Takes about 20 s for a 46 min camera take.

delay.description: How late the picture is against the sound, in seconds (0.08 for 80 ms). 0 puts it back. Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

media.description: The files to set the delay on. Default: every camera take.

makeDefault.description: Make it the delay new camera takes get, in Tandem's settings.

files.description: Files to line up with the camera take by sound, instead of a delay.

to.description: With files: the media ID or path of the file to line them up with. Default: the camera take.

place.description: With files: place each beside the take. Default true; false only sets their takes.

dryRun.description: With files: measure and check the edit without changing anything.

tools.name: archive
tools.title: Archive the project
tools.description: Makes the project standalone so it opens on another Mac. Without `to`, the media, LUTs and fonts it uses from outside its folder are copied into it (media/<folder they were in>/, assets/lut/, assets/font/) and the project is pointed at the copies as one undo step. With `to`, a standalone copy of the whole project folder is written inside that folder (proxies and mattes left out unless withCache), and the original is left alone. Copies are checked, never replace a different file, and are recorded in archive.json; missing files are listed and left as they are. dryRun: true lists what would be copied and the sizes first.

tools.name: loudness
tools.title: Loudness
tools.description: Measured loudness of each file with sound, the project's speech level (-20 LUFS unless changed) and master target (-14 LUFS), the gain each levelled clip gets, and how many speech clips aren't at the speech level, and which ones a limiter holds or would peak over the true peak ceiling once levelled (apply normalizeSpeech to level them and hold those peaks). With from, to, step or tracks it renders the mix instead and gives its loudness over time (momentary and short-term LUFS and peak at each step, as the timeline plays it, before export's master gain): use it for music swells, fades and sound effects against the voice. gains also checks each track's render against its gain lane and says where a gain change lands late or not at all. over lists where the mix peaks over a level, as stretches.

tools.title: Use an asset
tools.description: Downloads and normalises an asset if needed, copies it into the project's assets folder (a shared library asset, shared:..., is used where it is instead, and archiving copies it in), records the use for the credits and adds it to the project's media. With at it's also placed on the track for its kind (sound effects on SFX at -15 dB, music on Music at -31 dB with a fade out, stickers and logos on Graphics). One undo step, credited to you.

id.description: An asset ID from assets_search, like noto:1f680 or import:...

at.description: Place it here on the timeline. Leave out to only add it to the media. Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

duration.description: How long the clip lasts. Default: all of it (5 s for a still). Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

mode.description: place (default) fails if its track is taken there.

anchor.description: Where a picture sits: fitted to 40% of the frame's width and 30% of its height at this edge or corner. Stickers default to bottom.

pop.description: Pop it in at the start and out at the end.

project.description: Path to the .tandem file (or its folder). Defaults to the configured project.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: assets_show
tools.title: Show an asset
tools.description: What the library knows about one asset, without downloading anything: its name, kind, provider (and model), the prompt a generated one was made from, duration, loudness, licence and credit, and the file it plays from. Use it instead of reading meta.json.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: assets_credits
tools.title: Description credits
tools.description: The credits block for the video description, built from the assets the project uses and their recorded licences, plus anything to sort out before publishing (unknown licences, subscriptions to keep).

includeOptional.description: Also list courtesy credits nobody requires.

project.description: Path to the .tandem file (or its folder). Defaults to the configured project.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: assets_generate
tools.title: Generate a sound or music
tools.description: Makes a sound effect (0.5 to 30 s) or a music cue (3 to 600 s, instrumental) with ElevenLabs and adds it to the library. Each take is a paid request, so make one unless asked for more. Check assets_providers first if it fails.

prompt.description: What it should sound like, like "short airy whoosh, left to right".

variations.description: Takes to make, each paid. Default 1, at most 4.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: segments_list
tools.title: List saved segments
tools.description: Mike's saved segments (an intro, an outro, like and subscribe, comment below) in the shared library's Segments folder: each one's name, length, clips, the tracks it goes on and the fields it asks for.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: segments_save
tools.title: Save clips as a segment
tools.description: Saves clips from the timeline as a reusable segment in the shared library (Segments/<name>/), with copies of the files they play beside it so it stands on its own. Name the clips exactly (clipIDs, linked partners aren't added) or give a range (from and to: every clip wholly inside). fields turns titles into words asked for on insert, each {"clipID": ..., "label": ...}. Doesn't change the project.

name.description: What it's called in the library, like Intro.

from.description: Or: every clip wholly after this time... Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

to.description: ...and before this one. Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

fields.description: Titles whose words are asked for on insert; the words now are the default.

replace.description: Replace a segment already called that. Files only the old one had stay (projects play them); the rest goes to the Trash.

project.description: Path to the .tandem file (or its folder). Defaults to the configured project.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: segments_insert
tools.title: Insert a segment
tools.description: Puts a saved segment on the timeline at a time: its clips go on tracks of the same names (made if missing), linked, as one undo step credited to you. Its files are used where they are in the library, added to the project's media as needed; archiving the project copies them in. values fills its fields.

at.description: Where it starts. Seconds or mm:ss.mmm.

values.description: Words for its fields, by key.

mode.description: place (default) fails where a track is taken; overwrite replaces what's there; insert pushes later clips right.

project.description: Path to the .tandem file (or its folder). Defaults to the configured project.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: assets_providers
tools.title: Asset sources
tools.description: Every asset source and whether it works now, with what to fix: a missing key, an ElevenLabs key without the sound_generation permission, a source that's off until its licence is agreed.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.

tools.name: effects
tools.title: Effects and layouts
tools.description: The effects addEffect accepts with their parameters and defaults, the transition types, the layout presets and the parameters setKeyframes can animate.

project.description: Path to the .tandem file (or its folder). Defaults to the configured project.

json.description: Return the raw JSON result instead of readable text.
